messages:
Elaine (Marketing): Heads-up 1 Pinebridge is happy to do a short customer spotlight tied to the benchmark we ran. Need to lock quote, schedule a 30m recorded convo, confirm legal on publishing charts, and set up lead routing. Goal: launch + webinar in ~3 weeks.
Sam (Content): Awesome. I can draft Qs and a short pull quote. Who's the PR contact and who owns the raw graphs?
Toni (AE): I own the account. PR is Julia Park (julia@pinebridge.ai). I'll intro. For leads: prefer Marketo hidden form that tags pinebridge-benchmark and notifies AE queue.
Raj (Legal): High level: we need written permission for any named performance claims/graphs. Use Customer Data & Quote Release template. Toni, please get that signed before publishing. Also flag any regulatory redaction needs.
Devon (CS): I can export the charts + CSVs. Note: two runs had transient throttling 1 I'll annotate and we should call out test conditions if we publish raw charts. Recommend an appendix slide with methodology for the webinar.
Sam (Content): Draft quote idea: "Redwood cut our tail latency in half on our production workload, allowing us to ship feature X faster." Too on-the-nose?
Elaine (Marketing): Love it. Sam, make a one-line and a two-line variant for web and tweet. Raj, can you pre-approve quote language that avoids exact numeric QPS until we have written opt-in?
Raj (Legal): Yes. Replace explicit numbers (e.g., 20k qps) with "our production workload"; if Pinebridge wants exact numbers public we'll need explicit opt-in on the release.
Toni (AE): I'll ask Julia whether they want the exact figures public. If not, we'll use 'production workload' + a percent improvement if they approve. Sending release form today.
ops-bot: Meeting room reserved: "Marketing-Case-Spotlight-B" on 1743350400 (2024-03-30 10:00 PT). Join: https://meet.redwood/rooms/marketing-case-spotlight-b
Devon (CS): Sam, sending annotated chart export now (with caption about environment). I'll include CSVs and a short notes.txt about outliers.
Sam (Content): Thanks. Interview Qs (shortlist): 1) What was your primary objective? 2) What baseline did you compare to? 3) How did Redwood change day-to-day ops? 4) Any surprises? 5) Can you approve this quote? I'll also send a recording guide + consent wording.
Elaine (Marketing): Format idea for webinar: 20-25 min case highlight + 10 min live demo + 15 min Q&A. Toni, confirm customer speaker availability. Devon, can you provide demo backup?
Toni (AE): Julia prefers a product-marketing rep to co-present; can bring a technical backup if needed. I'll confirm availability by EOD tomorrow.
Devon (CS): I can be the technical backup for demo/Q&A.
Raj (Legal): Once the release is signed, drop the signed PDF in #legal-approvals and ping me. I'll expedite review.
Sam (Content): I'll draft blog + social copy and share a PR for edits tomorrow morning. Quick check: embargo until webinar, right?
Elaine (Marketing): Correct 1 embargo until webinar date. Do not publish charts or quotes until signed release is confirmed.
Toni (AE): For inbound leads from the benchmark page: hidden Marketo form that tags pinebridge-benchmark, auto-notify AE queue and CS channel. I'll create the flow and request the webhook.
Sam (Content): I'll add a small CTA in the blog: "Request a benchmark readout" that posts to the hidden form.
Elaine (Marketing): Plan of record: Toni to obtain signed release, Devon to finalize charts + methodology appendix, Sam to draft collateral, Raj pre-approves non-numeric quote language, ops-bot booked recording room. Daily check-ins this week until the release is signed. :thumbsup:
Toni (AE): On it. Will update once the release is signed or if Julia requests numeric opt-in.
Raj (Legal): Standby to review signed PDF in #legal-approvals.
Devon (CS): Chart export sent to Sam & Elaine.
Sam (Content): Got the assets 1 first draft by tomorrow noon.
Elaine (Marketing): Thanks all 1 ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
